_readme: Keyed per variable with a reason each. Not a waiver: the gate FAILS on an
entry that no longer applies, so this file cannot outlive its contents.
'undocumented' = read by code, intentionally absent from docs/configuration.md.
'dead' = documented, read nowhere, kept for a stated reason.
A new variable belongs in the doc, not here, unless one of these shapes fits.

undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_ALLOW_INSECURE_TLS: Build-time only: scripts/governance/validate-security-headers.mjs. Never read by the server.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_BODY_MAX_LENGTH: Removed setting. The one remaining read (runtimeConfig.ts:343-345) exists solely to WARN that it is no longer recognized, so it must not be listed as a live setting -- it is in the 'Removed / not implemented' table instead.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_COVERAGE_ALLOW_MISSING: Coverage-gate knob for scripts/governance/check-coverage.mjs. CI plumbing, not operator configuration.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_DASHBOARD_URL: Target URL for scripts/diagnostics/sqlite-validate.ps1. A diagnostic script's argument, not server configuration.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_DATA_DIR: Read only by scripts/dev/diagnostic/info-probe.mjs, which reports whatever is set. The server does not consult it.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_INSTRUCTIONS_DIR: Same: reported by info-probe.mjs only. INDEX_SERVER_DIR is the real setting and is documented.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_LOG_DIR: Same: reported by info-probe.mjs only. Log location follows STATE_ROOT.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_OPENSSL_BIN: Build-time override for scripts/build/generate-certs.mjs. Documented in docs/cert_init.md where it is relevant.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_PRECOMMIT_DOTENV: Pre-commit hook plumbing (scripts/hooks/pre-commit.*). Documented in docs/security_guards.md.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_SETUP_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS: Setup-wizard timeout. Belongs to the installer, not the running server.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_SETUP_PACK_TIMEOUT_MS: Setup-wizard timeout. Belongs to the installer, not the running server.
undocumented.INDEX_SERVER_URL: Target URL for the REST client scripts. Documented in docs/client_scripts.md where it is used.
